|lore=Floating prisoner interrogation droid. Uses probes and needles to dispense truth drugs and perform ‘surgery.’ Sensors determine subject’s pain threshold and truthfulness.
|game_text=Wherever you have a captive, your Force drains are +2. Once per game, may deploy Hypo from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Restraining Bolt and attrition < 3.
|printings={{Card versions/IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (A New Hope)}}

|notes=The original-layout slip for collector 39 survives in the February 2003 PDF. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 tournament legality, and the complete set was downloadable by 21 September. [[IT-0 (V) (Virtual Set 3)|Original]] and [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|Later edition]] show the retained publications.

The original slip names IT-0. The later heading adds Eyetee-Oh and uses IT-O, while its footer still uses IT-0 with the spelled-out name. The original article and later rendition already exist. The +2 Force drain at the captive’s location, Hypo deployment and both immunities remain. The later sentence does not print the separate word present.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 37. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
